name: sikasend
description: SikaSend: diaspora-to-Ghana remittances settled through NEAR Intents, paid out to mobile money by an agent with guardrails.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
